statement: Let X be a smooth proper variety over R and use its compatible Betti and algebraic de Rham realizations. On H_B(X(C),Q)⊗C let σ be coefficient conjugation, f∞ the rational Betti action induced by geometric conjugation, and τ the semilinear involution defining the de Rham real form. Comparison gives τ=f∞σ=σf∞. Hence στ=τσ=f∞ and f∞²=1. This uses the geometric comparison, not semilinearity alone; the finite-prime compatibility is a separate claim.
status_on_pages: Open on the pages at15/203 (à vérifier); stated without proof at18/033, with the geometric action and fixed-space explanation at18/035,037.
fate: The compatible geometric real structures give the identity by functoriality of comparison. Deligne’s real Hodge formalism supplies the published setting. The explicit counterexample to commutation of arbitrary semilinear involutions rules out the broader reading.
present_status: As of2026-11-19: established for the compatible realizations of a real variety; the geometry is an essential hypothesis.
fate_date: Grothendieck comparison: letter1963-10-14, publication1966; Deligne Hodge formalism1971 and real-comparison exposition1982.

reason: The nontrivial real Deuring gerbe at15/052 and the large-category real-neutralization doubt at15/207 have the same definite-quaternion obstruction. The precise common case, rather than every positive-characteristic motive, is merged.
statement: Assume a Q-linear rigid tensor category contains h¹(E) for a supersingular elliptic curve E over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p, all its geometric endomorphisms, and would send h¹(E) to a two-dimensional real vector space under an ordinary fibre realization. Its endomorphism algebra is the quaternion algebra B_(p,∞), whose real scalar extension is Hamilton’s division algebra H. A faithful H-action on R² is impossible, since every nonzero H-module has real dimension divisible by4. Thus this category has no such R-valued fibre functor and no neutralization over a totally real number field. The nonneutral quaternionic model gerbe is a valid comparison target; it is not an ordinary real fibre functor. Smaller categories require separate analysis.
status_on_pages: Stated without proof for the Deuring real gerbe at15/052; open on the pages for sufficiently large motivic pieces and totally real extensions at15/207.
fate: Voight Theorem42.1.9 identifies the geometric supersingular endomorphism algebra. The real-module obstruction is independently re-proved in both package audits. It answers the explicit large-category question under the stated all-endomorphisms and dimension hypotheses, while preserving the page’s broader exploratory formulation.
present_status: As of2026-11-19: the specified real and totally real neutralization is impossible. Equivalence to a nonneutral model gerbe and residual μ₂ ambiguity remain different issues.
fate_date: Deuring1941 underlying endomorphism theorem; Voight2021 precise opened statement; real-module proof checked2026-11-19.

statement: Suppose a real motivic Galois group G has an exact geometric/arithmetic sequence with quotient Γ, a quotient of Gal(C/R), and connected geometric kernel G_geom=G⁰. If f∞ lifts the nontrivial element when Γ has order2, then G is generated by G⁰ and f∞. This is the group-theoretic part of the proposed fullness statement; identifying the kernel with G⁰ and establishing the required realization fullness retain their motivic hypotheses. For the corrected Deligne–Milne setting, geometric connectedness uses the stated absolute-Hodge hypothesis; it is not automatic for all algebraic-correspondence motives.
status_on_pages: Proof sketch with conditional inputs at15/215; stated without proof with background conjectural hypotheses at18/034.
fate: The group-generation implication is formal. Corrected Deligne–Milne Props6.22(a),6.23(a) and footnote21 restore the absolute-Hodge hypothesis omitted in1982; Prop6.25 supplies the abelian case. Kahn’s exact-sequence framework does not remove the connectedness condition.
present_status: As of2026-11-19: conditional in general and established in the specified abelian/absolute-Hodge setting. Neither an exact arithmetic quotient alone nor the uncorrected1982 sentence proves the general claim.

statement: For a codimension-p algebraic cycle on a smooth complex algebraic variety, use the complex orientation and the manuscript’s algebraic residue comparison. Then cl_dR=(2πi)^p cl_B, equivalently P_top=(2πi)^(-p)P_an. Transport through a chosen field isomorphism σ:C→k transports the scalar as well: the Betti realization in algebraic de Rham coordinates is σ(2πi)^(-p) times the algebraic cycle class. Integral Betti classes map through the quotient by torsion. General Grothendieck-duality trace conventions may introduce additional dimension signs and must be compared separately.
status_on_pages: Local computation and reduction sketch at18/015–017, with the global argument left for completion; stated without proof with diagram reductions and a trace warning at18/019–021.
fate: The residue integral and product orientation are independently checked. Grothendieck1966 is the foundational comparison, not an exact located scalar theorem. Deligne1971 §§2.1.13–14,2.2.4–6 and Bost–Charles §1.1.2 fix compatible Tate/cycle conventions; Sastry–Tong Theorem4.1 documents the separate duality-trace sign issue.
present_status: As of2026-11-19: established with the stated orientation, residue and comparison conventions. Neither the local calculation nor a broad comparison citation erases the manuscript’s deferred global proof or settles an uncertain ink reading.
